content.title: Chapter 46 - HOUSING — Sec. 46-34. - Compensation; expenses.
content.summary:
A commissioner shall receive no compensation for his services, but shall be reimbursed
               for actual and necessary expenses incurred in the performance of his official duties.
(Code 1981, § 14-4; Ord. No. 1248, § 3, 6-16-1975)
State Law reference—
Similar provisions, C.R.S. § 29-4-205(4)…
